National Board of Revenue: This document is issued by the Internal Resources Division of the Ministry of Finance, which serves as the administrative authority overseeing customs and value added tax matters.
Ministry of Finance: The Ministry of Finance is the primary government authority responsible for the issuance of this regulatory notification.
Internal Resources Division: The Internal Resources Division under the Ministry of Finance functions as the specific department responsible for the administration and oversight of customs and value added tax policies.

processed_clauses.resolved_text: এস,আর,ও নং ২১০-আইন/২০২২/১১৮/কাস্টমস— Customs Act, 1969 (Act No. IV of 1969) এর section 19 এর sub-section (1) এবং মূল্য সংযোজন কর ও সম্পূরক শুল্ক আইন, ২০১২ (২০১২ সনের ৪৭ নং আইন) এর ধারা ১২৬ এর উপ-ধারা (১) এ প্রদত্ত ক্ষমতাবলে সরকার, জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ডের সহিত পরামর্শক্রমে, ২৪ মে, ২০২১ খ্রিস্টাব্দ মোতাবেক ১০ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪২৮ বঙ্গাব্দ তারিখে জারীকৃত প্রজ্ঞাপন এস,আর,ও নং ১২৯-আইন/২০২১/১৮/কাস্টমস এর নিম্নরূপ সংশোধন করিল, যথা:-

Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of this Act provides the legal authority for the government, in consultation with the National Board of Revenue, to issue or amend regulatory notifications.
Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty A: Section 126(1) of this Act serves as a foundational legal authority for the government to exercise regulatory powers, including amending existing customs and taxation notifications in consultation with the National Board of Revenue.
National Board of Revenue: The board is empowered to provide consultation to the government for the issuance or amendment of statutory regulatory orders regarding customs and taxation laws.
S.R.O. 129-AIN/2021: This existing statutory regulatory order is subject to formal amendment by the government through the issuance of this current notification.
